yearlyMessage: Focus on The Love of The Lord
monthFocus: Loved before you started; love is who God is.
intro: Heavenly Father, we thank You for this brand-new day and the opportunity to gather as family in Your presence. Your mercies are new every morning. Forgive us our sins and trespasses, and we forgive all who trespassed against us. We stand cleansed by the blood of Jesus.
outro: You have spoken life into your day. Walk boldly in the love of the Lord. You are blessed, covered, and victorious.

days.verse: God is love. Whoever lives in love lives in God, and God in them.
days.teaching: Love is not what God does; it is who He is. Month focus — The Eternal Source (Pre-creation love): Loved before you started; love is who God is. This week we carry "His Mercies Are New" (Lamentations 3:23). Wisdom for the Abundant Life flows from being loved first. Let 1 John 4:8, 16 settle you: God is love. Whoever lives in love lives in God, and God in them.
days.prayer: Heavenly Father, we thank You for this brand-new day and the opportunity to gather as family in Your presence. Your mercies are new every morning. Forgive us our sins and trespasses, and we forgive all who trespassed against us. We stand cleansed by the blood of Jesus. Give me wisdom to steward resources well. Break scarcity; teach me generosity.
days.declaration: I walk in Kingdom abundance to be a blessing.
days.decree: I walk in Kingdom abundance to be a blessing. God is love. Whoever lives in love lives in God, and God in them. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
days.action: Review one money choice; give or save as worship today.

Forgive us our sins and trespasses, and we forgive all who trespassed against us. We stand cleansed by the blood of Jesus. He moved first. Month focus — The Eternal Source (Pre-creation love): Loved before you started; love is who God is. This week we carry "Seek First the Kingdom" (Matthew 6:33). Wisdom for the Abundant Life flows from being loved first. Let Romans 5:8 settle you: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us. Now declare: I walk in Kingdom abundance to be a blessing. While we were still sinners, Christ died for us. In Jesus’ name, Amen. You have spoken life into your day. Walk boldly in the love of the Lord. You are blessed, covered, and victorious.

days.verse: It was because the Lord loved you.
days.teaching: Chosen by affection, not size. Month focus — The Eternal Source (Pre-creation love): Loved before you started; love is who God is. Let Deuteronomy 7:7-8 settle you: It was because the Lord loved you.
days.prayer: Heavenly Father, we thank You for this brand-new day and the opportunity to gather as family in Your presence. Your mercies are new every morning. Forgive us our sins and trespasses, and we forgive all who trespassed against us. We stand cleansed by the blood of Jesus. I put on the whole armour of God. No weapon formed against me shall prosper (Isaiah 54:17). I trample all the power of the enemy (Luke 10:19) and pull down every stronghold (2 Corinthians 10:4-5). Angels guard me in all my ways (Psalm 91:11).
days.declaration: I enforce the victory of the cross over my life and family today.
days.decree: I enforce the victory of the cross over my life and family today. It was because the Lord loved you. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

days.audioScript: Good morning, family of God. Welcome to today’s decree on the love of the Lord. Heavenly Father, we thank You for this brand-new day and the opportunity to gather as family in Your presence. Your mercies are new every morning. Forgive us our sins and trespasses, and we forgive all who trespassed against us. We stand cleansed by the blood of Jesus. You belong as a child. Month focus — The Eternal Source (Pre-creation love): Loved before you started; love is who God is. This week we carry "A Renewed Mind" (Romans 12:2). Spiritual Warfare (Praying the Scriptures) flows from being loved first. Let 1 John 3:1 settle you: See what great love the Father has lavished on us. Now declare: I enforce the victory of the cross over my life and family today. See what great love the Father has lavished on us. In Jesus’ name, Amen. You have spoken life into your day. Walk boldly in the love of the Lord. You are blessed, covered, and victorious.

days.verse: God is love. Whoever lives in love lives in God, and God in them.
days.teaching: Love is not what God does; it is who He is. Month focus — The Eternal Source (Pre-creation love): Loved before you started; love is who God is. This week we carry "Kingdom Ambition" (Mark 10:43-45). Sabbath Rest & Alignment flows from being loved first. Let 1 John 4:8, 16 settle you: God is love. Whoever lives in love lives in God, and God in them.
days.prayer: Heavenly Father, we thank You for this brand-new day and the opportunity to gather as family in Your presence. Your mercies are new every morning. Forgive us our sins and trespasses, and we forgive all who trespassed against us. We stand cleansed by the blood of Jesus. I enter Your rest (Genesis 2:3). I lay down heavy yokes (Matthew 11:28). Lead me beside still waters and restore my soul (Psalm 23). Renew my strength as I wait on You (Isaiah 40:31).
days.declaration: I rest in the finished work of Jesus; I am aligned for the week ahead.

sermons.bigIdea: Loved before you started; love is who God is.
points: 1. Receive: How wide and long and high and deep is the love of Christ.
2. Respond: Take 15 screen-free minutes in His presence; journal one gratitude.
